chartPrimitives.description: Legends, stable colors, formatters, segmented bars and data tables without a chart engine dependency.
chartPrimitives.longName: A long backup category name for checking legend wrapping in narrow containers
chartPrimitives.guidance: Capacity retains overflow values and scales drawing to fit; distribution retains unassigned totals. ChartLegend is static unless onSelect performs a consumer action. chartColor(1–7) reads the global palette: the first five colors serve comparison series, slot 6 is light gray neutral, and slot 7 is danger red. chartSeriesColor(id) is stable within the first five colors and may collide. Explicit colorIndex accepts all seven slots and takes precedence over legacy Badge color names. Status helpers remain separate. Percent takes 0.15, not 15; currency conversion belongs to business code.
